newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco C.Bank makes no injection at repo auction.
newsitem.headline: Morocco C.Bank makes no injection at repo auction.

text.p: Morocco's Bank al-Maghrib (central bank) made no injection in the money market for one week at its repurchase auction, a bank official said on Friday.
The bank received bids totalling 6.499 billion dirhams and allocated 2.500 billion dirhams at its newly-introduced 6.5 percent interest rate.
The amount was equal to the 2.500 billion dirhams leaving the market this week, the bank said. It satisfied 38.47 percent of the demand for liquidity.
The next auction is due on November 13, 1996, the official added. ($1= 8.6 dirhams) - Rabat newsroom +212-7 726518
